anita: Noticed multiple restore failures for archived DB snapshots after today's RBAC prune. Error: `KMS PermissionDenied` when attempting DEK unwrap.
ben: paste the restore log snippet?
anita: restore-job=arch-restore-125\n```
2026-03-26T09:03:12Z ERROR restore: decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller lacks cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
2026-03-26T09:03:12Z INFO snapshot_id=archive-db-20260201
```
sre-bot: IAM audit: Removed role `roles/storage.admin` from `serviceAccount:uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` at 2026-03-26T08:45:00Z
ben: uploader used to have both storage and delegated KMS rights via a broad role. RBAC cleanup removed that; KMS key policy didn't get updated.
dylan: quick mitigation options: 1) temporarily add decrypt binding to uploader SA; 2) run restores under `backup-decryptor` SA; 3) roll back RBAC PR. Given customer impact, temp grant is fastest.
ops-rotor: I applied a temporary conditional binding on `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/backups/cryptoKeys/db-archive-key` granting `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `serviceAccount:uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with condition `request.auth.claims.email=="uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" && request.time < timestamp("2026-03-26T10:30:00Z")`.
anita: re-ran restore: success. Restores for 3 tenants verified.
ben: next steps (owners):
- (SEC) map every pipeline path where uploader SA calls KMS decrypt. (assignee: anita)
- (ENG) refactor restore flow to call a dedicated decryptor service under `backup-decryptor` SA; remove direct decrypt from uploader. (assignee: dylan)
- (SRE) add pre-merge RBAC checks: diff `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` for backups keyring against baseline; require human review if decrypt bindings removed. (assignee: ops-rotor)
- (SEC) create alert on KMS key IAM deletions/removals for backups keyRing. (assignee: ben)
- (COMMS) notify affected customers with timeline and mitigation note. (assignee: anita)
anita: filed ENGSEC-3301 with logs and the temp grant details. I'll revoke the temporary binding at 10:25Z after handoff.
dylan: also check older snapshots that used legacy DEK wrapping; we may need a small rewrap migration for those.
ben: playbook update: after any RBAC prune, run restore smoke for a small snapshot for each region and verify KMS unwraps.
ops-rotor: CI smoke `restore-smoke/quick` passed after fix. https://ci.internal/restore-smoke/3189990001
anita: thanks all. Will follow up in the ENGSEC ticket and close once refactor PR lands. :thumbsup:
